dialogues.speaker: Levonty
dialogues.text: As a Ratnik, I respect every decision made by Sergeant Major Marushkin. For a soldier, obedience is fundamental.

dialogues.speaker: Levonty
dialogues.text: It's just that... I didn't go through all those selections and assessments just to be a watchman.

dialogues.speaker: Levonty
dialogues.text: The sergeant major even said to me, "Stay grounded and pay attention to how the others fight. Heroic fantasies will only get you killed." ... But so what?

dialogues.speaker: Levonty
dialogues.text: You know what a real hero looks like? Someone like Sigurd, someone who fights to the death and becomes a legend that everyone admires. Not someone who stands here day after day, watching the others return crowned in battle-glory.
